items.q: Who are the eBuddha Digitech alumni?
items.a: Learners who completed one of our programs in Bhopal or online and now work as digital marketers, SEO specialists, social media managers, content creators and developers, or run their own businesses. This page features 64 of them: 51 from digital marketing and 13 from IT and full stack development.

items.q: How many students have trained with eBuddha Digitech?
items.a: More than 21.5K learners have trained with us since 2018.

items.q: Can I see where alumni work now?
items.a: Yes. Each alumni card on this page shows the learner, their role and the company they work at. Together they work at 58 companies, including Amazon, Wipro, HCLTech, State Bank of India, IDFC FIRST Bank, Yamaha and Havells. Student and client stories are also on the Reviews page.

items.q: Have any alumni started their own businesses?
items.a: Yes. Seven alumni featured on this page run their own brands: Reena Das (Reena Glam Touch), Harshit Gupta (Ministeps), Sanju Abraham (Babytalks), Vedant Bhatt (Humanity Feeder), Anwesha Banerjee (SEO Anwesha), Vijay Ojha (Vishwakarma Electronics) and Anurag Kurmi (Balaji Bakery). Their journeys are in the Freshers to Founders section.

items.q: Which program did these alumni complete?
items.a: They come from our digital marketing, SEO, social media, performance marketing and full stack development programs, in classroom and online batches.

items.q: Do you have alumni in IT and full stack development?
items.a: Yes. 13 alumni from our full stack development program are featured here, working as full stack, frontend, backend and web developers and in data roles at HCLTech, Braintree, Lupin, Inadev, Mediquity Technologies and others.

items.q: How do I train like our alumni did?
items.a: Choose a program, fill in the enquiry form and our team will share the syllabus, fees and next batch date. The Bhopal course and the online course are the most popular starting points.
Our last three batches recorded a 96% placement rate, with 200+ hiring partners. Placement support includes resume help, mock interviews and portfolio guidance.

items.q: What kind of jobs do alumni get?
items.a: Digital marketing alumni work as Digital Marketing Executives and Managers, SEO Executives, Social Media Executives and Managers, Content Writers and Creators, Meta Ads Executives and Graphic Designers. IT alumni work as Full Stack, Frontend, Backend and Web Developers, Data Scientists and AIML Data Associates.

items.q: Which companies have hired eBuddha Digitech alumni?
items.a: Featured alumni work at 58 companies, from large employers such as Amazon, Wipro, HCLTech, State Bank of India, IDFC FIRST Bank, Yamaha, Havells, IndiaMART, Lupin and Rapido to agencies, startups and alumni-founded brands. The full logo list is in the Where Our Alumni Work section.

items.q: How can I get featured as an alumnus?
items.a: Message our team on WhatsApp at +91 84619 58162 or email ebuddhadigitech@gmail.com with your name, batch and current company.

items.q: How often is this alumni list updated?
items.a: We update it as alumni share their latest role and company. It was last updated on 6 November 2026. It shows a selection of our learners, not the complete alumni list.

items.q: Can my company hire from this list?
items.a: Yes. Share your open roles on the Hire From Us page. It is free for employers.
